account.follow.description: The button on a row of an account (a search's, a list's of follows, a notification's) that follows it.

account.follow_back.description: The follow of a row of an account that follows the reader.

account.request_follow.description: The follow of a row of a locked account, which approves its followers: it asks to follow.

account.following.description: In place of the follow of a row of an account the reader follows.

account.requested.description: In place of the follow of a row of an account the reader asked to follow, while it waits.
